name: Holtzman combat and equipment

sections.body:
An enabled belt stands ready while its wearer is idle and raises when they are drafted, fighting or struck. Recent combat keeps it active for 15 seconds after an attack, even if the pawn is undrafted. Sleeping and incapacitated pawns have no active field.

Fast projectiles, spring-loaded spike strikes and hurried melee blows spend field energy instead of wounding the wearer. The base cost is 0.012 energy per damage point, modified by the weapon’s shield-load profile. Each blocked hit delays recharge for twelve seconds. The hit that exhausts the reserve is still stopped, followed by a 30-second overload recovery.

The field lowers for ranged aiming, bursts and recovery. It remains down for at least one second and through the weapon’s cooldown plus half a second, leaving the shooter vulnerable. Toggling does not erase this delay or refill the reserve. Heat, explosions and EMP bypass the field; on exposed sand, an operating field also emits vibration that can attract a Maker.
sections.title: Protection and exposure

sections.body:
A practiced fighter can attempt to pass a deliberate blade through an active field. Suitable blades begin in Slow blade (auto) mode. Melee 10 gives a 20% penetration chance after a successful hit, increasing by five percentage points per level to 70% at Melee 20. The defender’s dodge and armor still apply.

Deliberate Cut or Stab attacks take twice their usual recovery against an active field. Unshielded targets use normal recovery, and fists or blunt weapon-butt strikes receive neither penetration nor the deliberate recovery penalty. Less skilled fighters must wear down the reserve with fast attacks.

Players can disable automatic fencing to force fast strikes; capable non-player fighters choose the technique themselves. Older saves that never recorded the previous false default adopt automatic fencing, while an explicitly saved disabled setting remains disabled.
sections.title: The slow blade

sections.body:
A Smuggler Drillshot projectile lodges on an active field for 90 ticks, or 1.5 seconds. It advances inward as the local field reaction changes from blue to red, then applies ten damage with 18% armor penetration. Only one dart can lodge on a target at a time; further hits neither stack the effect nor restart its timer. The lodged direction and remaining time survive saving.

Ordinary Maula, Karpov, support, Jabal and Richese darts remain fast projectiles. Their different shield loads affect how quickly a reserve is spent, but they do not acquire Drillshot penetration simply by being darts.
sections.title: Drillshot and ordinary darts

sections.body:
A faint blue contour follows the wearer’s body, head and clothing as they turn. Blocked impacts create local blue ripples; penetration and overload produce red reactions. A lodged Drillshot moves inward along that contour.

Use the belt’s reserve display as well as its appearance when judging protection. Energy units and remaining percentage are shown separately, and a visible field should not be treated as an unlimited defense.
sections.title: Recognizing the field

sections.body:
Beam contact with another active field overloads that belt for 60 seconds and creates a local blast with a 2.9-tile radius and up to 40 damage, falling with distance. This limited explosion is the mod’s gameplay interpretation of the dangerous lasgun–shield interaction.

A forced player attack warns when a ready automatic field lies in the firing line, including an idle field that contact could raise. Autonomous shooters avoid such lines and may close for melee. The shooter lowers their own field before firing. Misses and moving combatants can still change what the beam strikes.

A beam already stopped by an interceptor has no later contact with the protected target and cannot trigger a second hit or shield blast.
sections.title: Lasguns near shields

sections.body:
The civilian belt is the lightest and least costly configuration; the standard belt balances reserve and weight; the reinforced belt supports longer exposure at a greater material cost. All use the waist utility slot, so fields cannot be stacked.

At Normal quality, civilian, standard and reinforced reserves are 0.70, 1.10 and 1.50, with recharge rates of 0.10, 0.13 and 0.15 per second and masses of 2, 3 and 5 kg. Quality changes both reserve and recharge. At Good quality their reserve maxima are 0.84, 1.32 and 1.80, displayed as 84, 132 and 180 energy units.

Holtzman field engineering and machining recipes provide all three configurations, with ordinary armor trade as another route. Civilian and reinforced models are frontier variations created for this mod rather than separate canonical field technologies.
sections.title: Choosing a belt

sections.body:
The startup sound marks protection becoming active, including its return after shooting or overload. Equipping an idle belt does not by itself announce an active field. A separate breach sound accompanies successful slow-blade or drilling penetration and overload.

Ordinary blocked impacts do not use the breach cue. Listen for the change, then check the reserve and wearer’s condition before continuing the engagement.
sections.title: Activation and breach cues

sections.body:
A lasgun needs House precision industry research, Crafting 10 and a machining-table bill. Each weapon consumes one Imperial focusing assembly, 60 steel, 20 plasteel and four industrial components.

The focusing assembly is restricted procurement rather than a locally manufactured part or an ordinary trader stock item. Arrange the Imperial spice consignment before committing materials to a production plan; every additional lasgun needs another assembly.
sections.title: Assembling a lasgun

sections.body:
Desert smoke packs provide three smoke-cover charges. Sietch fire-safety packs provide one firefoam burst. Both compete with a shield belt for the utility slot, making the choice part of the wearer’s assignment.

Manufacturing pays for the initial Chemfuel charge. Refilling later costs ten Chemfuel for smoke or thirty for firefoam, including when topping up a partly used smoke pack. A full pack cannot be refilled. Keep fuel available if the colony relies on these devices for retreat or fire response.
sections.title: Smoke and fire-safety packs

sections.body:
These combat rules are available in the current alpha. Controlled ranged and melee encounters, burning fire and projectiles in flight have been checked across a full game restart on RimWorld 1.7.4995.

Those checks use supplied equipment and fixed skills. They do not establish every raid matchup or long-term campaign balance. The readability of the small lodged dart, moving field fit and live audio mix remain under review. Native recordings on RimWorld 1.7.4998 also include actual firearm attacks, shield activation and shield breach sounds; their final mix still awaits listening acceptance.
sections.title: Alpha notes

summary: A Holtzman field arrests fast impacts, forcing fighters to choose between sustained pressure, deliberate blade work and specialist weapons. Shooting opens a brief gap in the wearer’s protection.
